flags.reason: The Trainer superclass imported by models/mel/fscil_trainer.py is absent, so the documented training entry point fails during import.
The central MYNET model implementation is imported but absent, leaving the claimed method unimplemented and the training entry point unrunnable.
Base-session training explicitly selects test.csv, so the base model is trained on the same evaluation split used by the test loader.
Incremental training ignores the exact few-shot filenames in the session index and instead takes the first five images per class from test.csv, directly leaking test examples into training.
Every base-training epoch is evaluated on the test set and the maximum test accuracy selects the checkpoint, making the reported test result validation-tuned.
Prototype replacement unconditionally overwrites best_model_dict and the best checkpoint before checking its accuracy, so later sessions use it even when it is worse than the recorded best model.
Evaluation reports accuracy from logits1 alone although training accuracy and loss combine logits1 and logits2, so the second branch and part_weight do not affect the reported metric consistently.
Test accuracy is averaged equally across batches rather than across examples, overweighting the final partial batch and biasing the reported metric.
The default StanfordDog augmentation constructs a dtype with removed alias np.int, which crashes on NumPy 1.24 and newer.
get_optimizer always constructs AdamW, ignoring the advertised -optim choice (default SGD) and the parsed momentum setting.
Three configured dataset branches (cub200, StanfordCar, and Aircraft) import loader packages that are absent from the repository.
When batch_size_new is nonzero, the attention update loop overwrites data on every iteration and consequently updates attention using only the final shuffled batch.
The encoder unconditionally detaches the layer-3 output before both returning it and feeding layer 4, preventing gradients from reaching layers 1 through 3.
ResNet12Block returns the convolutional path without ever adding an identity or projected shortcut, contradicting the class/factory's ResNet designation.
CategoriesSampler ignores its n_cls argument and always samples group*way classes, so its public sampling contract can silently produce the wrong episode size.
The trainer records only aggregate encountered-class accuracy and never computes or saves the seen/unseen and harmonic-mean metrics that utils.save_result and its result schema expect.
No dependency or environment specification is provided despite nonstandard imports such as torch_dct and version-sensitive code such as np.int, preventing reproducible setup.
_make_layer references an undefined downsample variable whenever n_block is not 1, making the supposedly general layer builder crash for multi-block configurations.
DropBlock allocates masks and offsets with bare .cuda(), which can place them on a different device from x under CPU use or multi-GPU DataParallel.
Base loaders hard-code num_workers=8 and ignore the parsed -num_workers argument, unlike incremental loaders.
